title: Christine Larkin Autographed Signed Photo - Step By Step - 1996
descriptionText: The product is an original, autographed photo of Christine Larkin from the 1996 television show "Step By Step." This collectible item features a signature from the celebrity herself, adding value and authenticity to the piece. Perfect for fans of the show or collectors of celebrity memorabilia, this signed photo captures a moment in television history and serves as a unique keepsake for any fan of Christine Larkin.
